summary_en: 400,000 shares (1.5% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-07; upper limit ¥633.6M at ¥1,584/share closing price 2026-08-06; execution window 08:45 JST single session; results to be announced post-settlement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: MIYAJI ENGINEERING GROUP resolved at its 6 August 2026 board meeting to acquire up to 400,000 treasury shares (1.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 7 August 2026 at 08:45 JST, with an upper limit purchase price of ¥633.6 million. The acquisition price is based on the closing price of ¥1,584 per share on 6 August 2026. The order is limited to the single specified trading session; partial or no execution is possible depending on market conditions and order availability. The company stated the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Results will be announced after settlement on 7 August 2026. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,158,824 treasury shares against 27,677,816 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
